description: This PHP class defines the PartiallyClaimAttachment Data Transfer Object (DTO) used within the OrangeHRM Claim plugin. It encapsulates properties related to claim attachment details such as request ID, attachment ID, file information, description, and metadata including the date added and the employee who added it. The class employs multiple traits for auxiliary functionalities and provides methods to access and modify its properties, as well as retrieving related entities like ClaimRequest and Employee.

classes.name: PartialClaimAttachment
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing a claim attachment with details like IDs, file info, description, attached date, and associated employee and claim request references.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing all properties, setting references to employee and claim request entities based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated claim request.

methods.name: setRequestId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the associated claim request.

methods.name: getAttachId
methods.description: Returns the attachment ID.

methods.name: setAttachId
methods.description: Sets the attachment ID.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the attachment.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the attachment.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type or file type.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type or file type.

methods.name: getAttachedDate
methods.description: Returns the attached date as a string.

methods.name: setAttachedDate
methods.description: Sets the attached date after formatting it via helper.

methods.name: getClaimRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the associated ClaimRequest entity based on request ID.

methods.name: getAddedBy
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who added the attachment.

methods.name: setAddedBy
methods.description: Sets the ID of the user who added the attachment.

methods.name: getAddedByEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity who added the attachment.

methods.name: setAddedByEmployee
methods.description: Sets the addedByEmployee property to the Employee entity corresponding to addedBy ID.
